cardOverview.overviewText: HDFC Swiggy BLCK Credit Card is a premium co‑branded cashback card that gives you 10% cashback on Swiggy ecosystem spends, up to 5% on select online platforms, and 1% on other transactions, aimed at frequent digital spenders and lifestyle users.

items.title: Discover Reward Points Redemption Options
items.subtitle: To explore the full range of redemption options for this card, download the SaveSage Club app now.
